summary: A Cremorne cosmetic practice with 124 Google reviews appears to lose enquiries to dead menu links and an empty results section.

findings.problem: The Dental Services menu and its sub items, Specialist, Cosmetic, General and Implants, appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Patients exploring treatments cannot reach them.
findings.fix: Working pages behind every menu item.

findings.problem: The Before and After section appears to show six blank image placeholders, and the Our Partners and accreditation areas appear empty.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients buy on visible results and proof.
findings.fix: Real captioned cases and labelled accreditations.

findings.problem: The review widget and floating review button appear to link to an empty Google link, and no review text appears.
findings.cost: You miss a chance to show 124 reviews as proof.
findings.fix: A working review link and real quotes.

findings.problem: The disclaimer appears to contain garbled wording about the theatre, and the booking dropdown options appear to run together on one line.
findings.cost: Garbled text and a broken form look careless on a premium site.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and a clean form.

redesign: Review proof and a clean form.
